chars.SARA: SARA: a 19-year-old Moroccan girl with long dark curly hair in a low ponytail, wearing a mustard-yellow puffer jacket over a white hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.KARIM: KARIM: a 43-year-old Moroccan man with a short greying beard, receding hairline and a gold wedding ring, wearing a maroon leather jacket over a black turtleneck and dark grey trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: SARA sits alone on the edge of a small bed in a cramped student room in Montreal, Canada, snow falling outside the window behind her, a suitcase still half unpacked at her feet, she looks lonely and worried, hugging her knees.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SARA sits at a small desk at night in her student room, holding her phone close, scrolling through a social media group with a hopeful curious face, the screen glow lighting her face, phone screen turned away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SARA walks alone on a snowy Montreal street at dusk among tall buildings and strangers in winter coats, she looks small and lost, clutching her phone, red brick buildings and street lamps.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: KARIM sits in the driver's seat of a silver sedan parked on a snowy Montreal street, smirking slyly as he looks at his phone, a child's car seat visible in the back seat.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: KARIM stands in the kitchen of a family apartment in Canada, secretly looking at his phone with a sneaky grin, while two small children play with toys on the floor behind him, warm evening light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: KARIM sits on a sofa at night typing a message on his phone with a fake friendly smile, leaning forward eagerly, a framed family photo on the wall behind him, phone screen turned away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: KARIM steps out of his silver sedan in front of a Canadian college campus covered in snow, adjusting his maroon leather jacket and looking around like a hunter, confident and sly.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In a busy Montreal cafe, KARIM sits at a table in the background staring intently at SARA with a predatory smile, while SARA stands at the counter in the foreground ordering a coffee, unaware and innocent, tense mood.
